item.title: 🔴 Ransomware Groups Turn to Citrix Bleed 2, BYOVD, and Supply Chain Credentials
item.description:

item.title: 🟠 CVE-2026-50521 Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
Added Edge software to the Security Updates table. Customers that are running supported version of Edge are encouraged to update to the indicated version to be protected from this vulnerability.

Source: Microsoft Security Response Center  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 9h ago

item.title: 🟠 CVE-2026-57100 Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
item.description:
Why this matters: Could impact sign-ins/MFA/Conditional Access — watch for login issues.
Server-side request forgery (ssrf) in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service (SyncFabric) allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

Source: Microsoft Security Response Center  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 9h ago
